title: She Held the Roof of a Runaway Sky Train
altTitles: Hold the Roof | Stick Figure Mini-Movie
One Staff vs. a Train Full of Goons
description: The next shard rides the sky-rail. Smudge sent everyone he ever drew. Nova holds the roof. #stickfigure #animation #INKLIGHT
topic: L03 F2 set-piece action + F5 choreography: Nova holds the roof of the runaway sky train

sections.label: S1 Hook: the sky-rail

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The next shard rides the sky-rail.

sections.videoPrompt: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading. <<<image_3>>> NOVA: a tall slender black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, magenta (#FF3DA5) glowing eyes and rim light, a single curved topknot line rising from the head, carrying a glowing magenta bo staff holding the glowing magenta bo staff in her right hand. A sleek sky-rail train bursts out of a towering white cloudbank at full speed on a single elevated rail high above a sunlit cloud sea, and the camera sweeps along it to reveal Nova standing on the roof, spinning her staff into glowing magenta rings, then planting it. Helicopter orbit ending at low angle, bright afternoon sun, cloud glare, wind-whipped rim light.
